claim_ceiling: Stage 11V may establish that, if the 3,413 observed nonblank target fields are held fixed and the 4,193 blank fields are unconstrained for one target-field value at a time, Sunset's completed full-cohort field share can range from 1,553 of 7,606 (20.418%) to 5,746 of 7,606 (75.546%).
